```{=html}
<script>
// Chapters stay hidden until a thread is chosen; clicking the open thread again closes it.
(function () {
  document.documentElement.classList.add("threads-js");
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".thread[data-panel]");
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll(".thread-panel");
  function show(name, scroll) {
    panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("active", p.id === "thread-" + name));
    cards.forEach(c => {
      const on = c.dataset.panel === name;
      c.classList.toggle("active", on);
      c.setAttribute("aria-expanded", on);
    });
    const panel = name && document.getElementById("thread-" + name);
    if (panel && scroll) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }
  cards.forEach(c => c.addEventListener("click", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = c.classList.contains("active") ? null : c.dataset.panel;
    history.replaceState(null, "", name ? "#thread-" + name : location.pathname);
    show(name, !!name);
  }));
  const fromHash = (location.hash.match(/^#thread-(\w+)/) || [])[1];
  show(fromHash || null, !!fromHash);
})();
</script>
```
